title: STEK: Structural-Terrain-Enhanced Koopman-Inspired Cross-Channel Regularization for Retrospective Battery Multi-Target Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06299v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrospective battery characterization across heterogeneous cells is challenging because cycling records vary substantially with chemistry, protocol, cell format, capacity, and operating conditions. An endpoint charge--discharge curve captures the local condition of an evaluated cycle, while a cell-level lifecycle terrain summarizes structural evolution across the archived trajectory. We propose STEK, a structural-terrain-enhanced framework for retrospective battery multi-target estimation. STEK combines a cell-level lifecycle (dQ/dV) terrain with an endpoint-derived structural proxy through quality-proxy-conditioned gating. Bounded FiLM and a validity-gated residual head refine the endpoint-curve representation while preserving a curve-based prediction pathway. translated_title: STEK：面向回溯性电池多目标估计的结构-地形增强Koopman启发跨通道正则化方法
translated_abstract: 跨异构电池的回溯性电池表征极具挑战性，因为循环记录随化学体系、测试协议、电池形式、容量和工作条件的变化而存在显著差异。端点充放电曲线捕捉被评估循环的局部状态，而电池级生命周期地形则总结了存档轨迹中的结构演化。我们提出STEK，一个用于回溯性电池多目标估计的结构-地形增强框架。STEK通过质量代理条件门控将电池级生命周期(dQ/dV)地形与端点导出的结构代理相结合。有界FiLM和有效性门控残差头在保留基于曲线的预测路径的同时细化端点曲线表示。电池类型和可选的材料文本表示进一步对以恒等映射为中心的低秩线性映射进行条件化，提供Koopman启发的跨通道一致性目标。
tldr: STEK框架通过质量代理条件门控将电池级生命周期(dQ/dV)地形与端点充放电曲线相融合，并引入Koopman启发的跨通道一致性正则化，实现了跨异构电池的回溯性多目标估计。
en_tdlr: STEK is a structural-terrain-enhanced framework that fuses cell-level lifecycle (dQ/dV) terrain with endpoint charge-discharge curves via quality-proxy-conditioned gating, employing Koopman-inspired cross-channel consistency regularization for retrospective battery multi-target estimation across heterogeneous cells.
